method: Independent native-agent and root visual review of the exact three indexed projections, all 12 distance corners, all 15 state/alignment cases, the 72-pose motion sheet, exact point-source metrics, assembled product views, isolated setup-side views, and modeled reset/beam cues.
acceptance: Rabbit, fox, and owl must each read unmistakably without captions in the exact indexed projections and every tested distance/alignment case.
All three states must be challenged at centered and plus-or-minus two-degree yaw and pitch, and at every source/wall distance corner.
The 5-degree cycle must expose the complete transition truthfully as an eclipse wipe rather than imply continuous animal recognition.
An assembled view must demonstrate the fixed rabbit-home pointer together with its matching reel mark, and the phone-side cue must unambiguously communicate light direction.
Digital judgment must not be represented as human recognition, delight, room-light, finite-emitter, physical-use, or durability evidence.
